content.value: Mention the characteristics of a sediment particle. Determine annual soil loss (Ida silt (15) loam) from an upland farm of 1675 acres with Rainfall Erosivity Factor, 250. The topographic factor is 0.4 and the land is covered with grass. If the slope steepness increases to 8% (topographic factor is 0.928), find the changes in soil erosion.
